quote: Baker Hughes (NASDAQ: BKR), an energy technology company, announced Monday a significant order from Petrobras for workover and plug and abandonment (P&A) services in pre-salt and post-salt fields offshore Brazil. The multi-year project, set to start in the first half of 2025, will be managed with Baker Hughes’ integrated solutions portfolio to optimize performance for Petrobras.
note: Opened Baker Hughes investor English primary 10 Jun 2024; CapEx/contract USD not disclosed; Macae facility expansion noted.
